question: Submission description (a short paragraph)
answer: A reference-free multilingual translation error span detection system based on Qwen3-14B. The English-German system is trained with supervised fine-tuning followed by GRPO. The English-Chinese system is further trained on a mixture of English-German and English-Chinese data. The system takes the source sentence and machine translation as input and predicts minor and major error spans without using the provided reference translations.
